toolkit_card.title: Generic invariant recognition card
toolkit_card.recognition_trigger: A familiar relation appears under its declared validity conditions.
toolkit_card.invariant: The governed relation remains unchanged under the stated transformation.
toolkit_card.derivation_anchor: Start from the canonical relation and apply the declared transformation without changing its assumptions.
toolkit_card.shortcut: Use the invariant directly after confirming the domain.
valid_when: the requested quantity is unchanged by the transformation
fails_when: the transformation changes the requested quantity
toolkit_card.trap: Do not use a memorised shortcut before checking the governing assumptions.
toolkit_card.verification_check: Substitute the transformed state back into the canonical relation.

lightning_drill.prompt: Which check must happen before using the shortcut?
lightning_drill.answer: Confirm that the canonical validity conditions still hold.
